About Us

A studio built on care, craft and honest design

We believe great interiors come from listening first, to you, to the space, and to the way you want to live in it.

Our Story

Design that feels like home

Boston Interior began with a simple idea: that a well designed space should feel personal, not showroom perfect. Founded by Sabrah, the studio grew from styling projects for friends and family into a full service practice serving homes and businesses across Tanzania and East Africa.

Today our team of designers, project managers and craftspeople handles everything from the first floor plan to the last cushion, always with warm materials, honest budgets and details that stand up to everyday life.

Sabrah

Founder & Creative Director

Our Mission

Spaces that work as beautifully as they look

To design interiors that balance beauty and function, guiding every client from idea to completion with transparency, craftsmanship and respect for their budget.

Our Vision

East Africa's most trusted design studio

To be known for warm, timeless interiors and furniture, and for making professional design feel approachable for every home and business we work with.
